title: Final live source check does not retain a coherent Git index through staged-entry verification
description: Exact7d now catches staged index-only drift already present when its cached paths are enumerated. However, cached paths and entry blobs are read once, followed by working-file checks and a HEAD-only final check. No index proof is retained through these reads. During the last live check after the complete receipt flush, a real private index update after cached enumeration adds an unrelated changed contract outside the captured list and still returns complete. A second probe replaces the permitted owner index blob after its real cat-file read; the stale read still matches the installed accepted owner and completion succeeds even though the current index contains an unaccepted blob. HEAD and all installed owner/contract bytes remain accepted in both cases.
locators: src/mediaingredientmech/curate/campaign_owner_apply.py:1338-1339 (finish_receipt final recheck followed by complete return)
reproduction: Run provenance/probe_index_window.py under the recorded Python against frozen7d. Native apply and receipt helper functions are not replaced. A sys.setprofile hook stages actual installed accepted owner endpoints on entry to the real finish_receipt. Once the receipt is flushed complete, it schedules a real git hash-object/update-index operation either after the actual cached diff returns, or after actual cat-file returns. Hooks neither substitute results nor change native code. Both late modes complete and verify historically while the recorded real index differs from approved scope/bytes.

controls.positive: Actual installed endpoints staged before native finish complete; subsequent legitimate commit still verifies historically.
controls.negative: The same unrelated index mutation scheduled before the actual cached diff is refused with a failed recovery receipt.

injections.phase: after actual cached enumeration returned in final recheck
after actual staged owner blob read returned in final recheck

minimal_fix_scope: Bind the index state used for cached enumeration and stage/blob validation through the end of each live check, and refuse concurrent changes before success. Use a coherent stage/path/mode/blob snapshot or equivalent native-safe verification; account for legitimate Git stat-cache refresh instead of blindly prohibiting every index-file metadata change. Preserve legitimate installed endpoint staging between boundaries, literal paths, and historical completed verification without a current-index lock. Do not merely add a HEAD check, which cannot see index-only changes.
required_tests: Actual final-recheck index addition after cached enumeration must refuse and leave honest failed recovery evidence.
Actual planned-owner index substitution after its genuine blob read must refuse; working bytes/HEAD remain unchanged to isolate index freshness.
Clean actual installed-endpoint staging and later historical validation still pass; initial/postprepare/midflight hidden-index controls remain refused.
Unrelated cached paths, conflict stages, mode mismatch, intent-to-add and premature deletion/accepted payload must remain refused with all original tests intact.

Original residual examples are now refused; this narrower final-read coherence gap remains. Original #1255/NUL handling not reopened. Coordinator owns deduplication/filing before any code repair.
